summary: Code review and console log analysis of Mobile Voice Full Recovery (10-phase implementation). All phases verified via code inspection and console log capture. Session management issues prevented full E2E Live Cooking Modal testing, but core speech controller functionality confirmed working.

phase_1_environment_detection.evidence: Console logs show: [HandsFree Phase-1] Feature Status with proper isMobile/isWebView detection

phase_2_user_activation.evidence: hasUserGesture tracking, hasValidUserGesture() with 5s timeout, recordUserGesture()

phase_3_isolated_synthesis.evidence: Synthesis and Recognition have separate state management, speak() does not touch recognition

phase_4_safe_recognition_init.evidence: safeStartRecognition() with try-catch, InvalidStateError handling, recognition doesn't auto-start

phase_5_fallback_voices.evidence: loadVoices() with fallback chain: Google/Samantha/Alex -> English local -> Any English -> Default

phase_6_strict_user_only_cancel.evidence: Console shows: [LiveCooking] Orchestrator stop signal ignored (speech owned by user). userOnlyReasons whitelist in cancelSpeech()

phase_7_ui_state_management.evidence: Mic button shows Disabled/Tap Mic/Listening/Speaking/Error states with color-coded indicators

phase_8_webview_compatibility.evidence: WebView detection checks for Capacitor/Cordova/wv, requires manual mic activation

phase_9_error_handling.evidence: Recognition errors handled gracefully - not-allowed sets permission-needed state, mobile errors don't auto-retry

phase_10_singleton_controller.evidence: SpeechController class with singleton pattern, instance variable, proper initialization
